title: Smartphone camera processing, metadata and lens calibration for face capture

queue.claim: FocalLengthIn35mmFilm on iPhone, Pixel and Samsung includes digital zoom and lens crops (2x reports ~48 mm). Whether it is updated for 16:9 and 1:1 crops of the 4:3 sensor is untested. A static tag on a 16:9 crop makes the diagonal formula underestimate f_px by 8.2%, and on a 1:1 crop by 15%.
queue.query: iPhone 16:9 photo EXIF FocalLengthIn35mmFilm value compared with 4:3 same lens

queue.claim: Main and telephoto JPEG/HEIC output on Apple, Google and Samsung phones is already distortion-corrected, with residual |k1| ≲ 0.01–0.02 (focal-normalised), so k can be fixed at 0 for centred faces.
queue.query: smartphone main camera JPEG residual radial distortion after in-camera correction calibration k1 measurement

queue.claim: Android CameraCharacteristics.LENS_DISTORTION (API 28) uses Brown-Conrady [k1,k2,k3,k4,k5]. Its documented coordinates are centred on the optical centre and normalised so the farthest edge is 1 (|r| ≤ √2), unlike OpenCV's focal-normalised coordinates.
queue.query: LENS_DISTORTION "normalized to be 1 at the edge further from the optical center"

queue.claim: pillow-heif is BSD-3-Clause, but its wheels bundle libheif and libde265 (LGPL-3.0) and x265 (GPL-2.0+). rawpy is MIT over LibRaw (LGPL-2.1 or CDDL-1.0). Pillow is MIT-CMU.
queue.query: pillow-heif license x265 GPL libheif LGPL bundled wheels

queue.claim: AVCameraCalibrationData lensDistortionLookupTable holds relative radial magnification at n linearly spaced radii up to the farthest corner from lensDistortionCenter (p' = c + (p−c)(1+m)). The forward table maps rectified to distorted and the inverse maps distorted to rectified. Calibration comes with AVDepthData, and may or may not survive in Camera-app HEIC files.
queue.query: AVCameraCalibrationData lensDistortionLookupTable inverseLensDistortionLookupTable relative radial magnification

queue.claim: Apple exposes face-aware (content-aware) wide-angle correction via AVCapturePhotoSettings.isAutoContentAwareDistortionCorrectionEnabled (iOS 14+). Google shipped the Shih, Lai & Liang 2019 stereographic face warp on Pixel wide and selfie captures.
